scenarios.name: Conditional (304)
scenarios.note: Sent twice, the second time with the ETag. GitHub doesn't charge for a 304, and Postern's rate-limit numbers should agree.

scenarios.name: Redirect
scenarios.note: The archive redirects to another host. Postern hands the 302 back; following it would send the app token to the wrong place.

scenarios.name: Streaming (SSE)
scenarios.note: fake-upstream writes four events a quarter of a second apart. If they all arrive together, something between buffered them.
